{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter for converted customers
converted_data = data[data['converted'] == 1]

# Exclude rows where customer_age == -1 (missing data)
valid_converted_data = converted_data[converted_data['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute the mean age
mean_age = valid_converted_data['customer_age'].mean()

print(mean_age)"}
